description: Plane: rules file and change work items in a Plane project.
Vikunja: rules file and change tasks in a Vikunja project.
WordCraft: Word documents kept as native files, edited by people and agents.
GridCraft: Excel workbooks kept as native files, edited by people and agents.
DeckCraft: PowerPoint presentations kept as native files, edited by people and agents.
PdfCraft: PDF documents kept as native files, edited by people and agents.
CADCraft: DXF and DWG drawings kept as native files, edited by people and agents.
PhotoCraft: Photoshop documents kept as native files, edited by people and agents.
VectorCraft: SVG drawings kept as native files, edited by people and agents.
DesignCraft: InDesign layouts, as IDML, kept as native files, edited by people and agents.
FigCraft: interface designs kept as native files, edited by people and agents.
FreeCAD: 3D models kept as native files, edited by people and agents.
Blender: 3D scenes kept as native files, edited by people and agents.
FilmCraft: video projects rendered and exported, one file at a time.
EffectCraft: motion graphics rendered and exported, one file at a time.
SoundCraft: audio sessions mixed down and exported, one file at a time.
LightCraft: photos developed and exported, one file at a time.
Forms: the agent asks with a form, and people fill it in the chat.
Dashboards: the agent shows figures and charts as a dashboard in the chat.
Mini apps: small apps the agent writes, run apart from the portal.
Diagrams: Excalidraw drawings that people and agents draw on together.
Math: formulas in messages and documents, typeset.
Mermaid: diagrams written as text in messages, drawn.
